mutants.description: The second stage is written as the receiving end of a toggle (pulse) synchroniser: sync_out flips whenever the first stage holds 1, instead of copying the level
mutants.reason: When async_in is held at 1 after reset, sync_out toggles every clock instead of settling at 1. A level input then shows up at the port as a square wave, and a fault that stays asserted reads as asserted only every other clock.

mutants.description: The synchroniser output is turned into a rising-edge detector on the synchronised level: sync_out goes high for one clock when meta_ff rises, not for as long as async_in stays high
mutants.reason: When async_in rises and stays high, sync_out pulses high for one clock and then alternates instead of holding 1. Any consumer that needs a steady level (enable, fault) sees the input drop out every other clock.
